question_en:
I am the music librarian for a community choir and need to perform a print pre-check on all sheet music records in the image. Please answer:

How many downloadable scanned images does each record actually provide? According to the following rules, which processing category should they be assigned to: records with at least 5 images belong to "Multi-page Print Review," while records with fewer than 5 images, as well as all collection-level records, belong to "Supplementary Check." Please provide a complete list covering all records in the image, stating the sheet music title, number of downloadable scanned images, and processing category for each row; then list all sheet music titles and their scan counts assigned to "Multi-page Print Review."

The answer must include a table with "Sheet Music Title—Number of Downloadable Scanned Images—Processing Category," followed by a list after the table of all sheet music titles entering "Multi-page Print Review," their scanned image counts, and the total number of selected records.
